title: Trump Signals 'Decisive Decision' on Iran, Warns of Imminent Escalation
detail: President Trump hinted at an imminent 'decisive decision' on Iran, signaling potential escalation against the regime and heightening war risk. The remarks raised alarm among regional observers and allied capitals already on edge following recent Gulf corridor incidents.

title: UN Fact-Finding Mission Finds 'Reasonable Grounds' of US War Crimes in Iran Strikes
detail: A UN Human Rights Council-mandated fact-finding mission concluded there are reasonable grounds to believe the US committed war crimes in two February 28 strikes that killed at least 178 civilians: a missile strike on the Al-Shajareh Tayyebeh school in Minab (157-168 killed, mostly children, per Iranian state media and the mission's own accounting) and a strike using tungsten-pellet-dispersing munitions on a sports complex and residential area in Lamerd (22 killed). CENTCOM denied responsibility for the Lamerd strike; the White House, State Department and Pentagon did not respond to requests for comment. The same report found Iranian state security forces committed crimes against humanity 'on a staggering scale' while crushing nationwide protests in late 2025 and early 2026.

media.caption: A cemetery in Minab, Iran, site of a February 28 strike the UN says may constitute a US war crime
